bgs_coal_2004.title: BGS Coal Resources for New Technologies
bgs_coal_2004.attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI; BGS/Coal Authority 1999 geological base. Retrieved 29 September 2026.
bgs_coal_2004.limitation: 1:1,000,000 legacy compilation. Contains both exposed and concealed coal-bearing strata, not continuous coal seams. Modern economic assumptions do not define geological absence.

pgi_midas.title: PIG-PIB MIDAS documented and archived mineral-deposit boundaries
pgi_midas.license: PIG-PIB public-sector information reuse conditions; attribution/date/processing disclosure and original database terms
pgi_midas.attribution: PIG-PIB, MIDAS documented deposits layer0 and selected archived deposits layer3, retrieved 29 September 2026. Coal-only subset; API reprojection to WGS84 and schema normalization by Earth research.
pgi_midas.limitation: Deposit documentation boundaries can be reconstructed from mining-area boundaries; original caveats retained. Current registry does not mean currently operating. Archived register is explicitly incomplete. Full source reuse conditions remain applicable.

saxony_ruk400.title: LfULG Saxony RÜK400 fossil fuels
saxony_ruk400.attribution: Geodaten Sachsen, LfULG, RÜK400Bre, retrieved 29 September 2026; selected coal-seam polygons reprojected by Earth research.
saxony_ruk400.limitation: 1:400,000 coal-seam distributions. Individual seam layers overlap vertically; do not sum feature counts or overlap to infer abundance. Aggregate duplicate seam layer and pit boundaries excluded.

saxony_lignite50.title: LfULG Saxony lignite-field inventory
saxony_lignite50.attribution: Geodaten Sachsen, LfULG, Lagerstättenkataster Braunkohle 1:50,000, retrieved 29 September 2026; reprojected by Earth research.
saxony_lignite50.limitation: Named inventory fields overlap seam distributions. Source IDs retained; names are not guessed from identifiers. Publication page supplies scale; individual mining/depletion/depth status absent.

nrw_rk500.title: Geologischer Dienst NRW IS RK500
nrw_rk500.attribution: IS RK500 (https://www.opengeodata.nrw.de/produkte/geologie/geologie/RK/ISRK500/), Geologischer Dienst NRW, Abrufdatum 29.09.2026. Nutzung gemäß Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0. Coal and rock-salt subsets reprojected by Earth research.
nrw_rk500.limitation: 1:500,000 generalized resource areas. Actual layer and attribute say hard coal to 2000 m; landing page says 200 m. Preserve source 2000 m and flag this conflict; no shallow-access inference.

ga_basins_2013.title: Geoscience Australia Coal Basin Outlines
ga_basins_2013.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia), Australian Coal Basins 2013, Bioregional Assessment Source Dataset, retrieved 29 September 2026; reprojected by Earth research.
ga_basins_2013.limitation: Full province extents including covered regions; best use1:2M–1:5M; original metadata says pre-release not fully QA checked. RANK field is geological province rank, not coal rank. No assumption that entire basin contains coal.

nsw_coalfields.title: NSW Mining Coalfields
nsw_coalfields.attribution: NSW Department of Industry 2016 / Geological Survey of NSW, Standing Committee 1976 coalfield definitions; retrieved 29 September 2026. API reprojection and normalization by Earth research.
nsw_coalfields.limitation: Five named coalfield areas derived from structural basins, not seam-by-seam ore extents. Source original CRS GDA94. Existing restricted BA-derived contour dataset not used; independently released open source used.

victoria_coalfields.title: Victorian Coal Fields 2006 inventory
victoria_coalfields.attribution: Victorian Government DEECA / Geological Survey of Victoria, COALINVFLDS, retrieved 29 September 2026; WFS output and schema normalization by Earth research.
victoria_coalfields.limitation: 46 fields may contain multiple seams. Source age, overburden, development, resources and accuracy-code fields retained without converting reserve tonnage into grade. Linked seam lookup tables not imported.

ga_aimr_2025.title: Australia's Identified Mineral Resources 2025, coal resource sites
ga_aimr_2025.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia), AIMR 2025 coal layers 32/33, retrieved 29 September 2026.
ga_aimr_2025.limitation: Supplementary resource-site points, not basin footprints; includes supplied site status without operating-mine filtering. Size class is resource tonnage, not grade or universal accessibility.

usgs_india_2011.title: USGS GIS representation of coal-bearing areas in India and Bangladesh
usgs_india_2011.license: Use constraints:none; acknowledge USGS and cited original sources
usgs_india_2011.attribution: USGS Trippi/Tewalt et al., OFR2011-1296, underlying Geological Survey of India Bulletin45 and listed sources; retrieved 29 September 2026; datum transformed by Earth research.
usgs_india_2011.limitation: Legacy georeferenced coal-bearing formation outlines; some contacts are USGS interpretations under alluvium. Formation identities not included. Indian 1975 (EPSG:4240) datum converted for display; no rank inferred from location.

usgs_china_2014.title: USGS Chinese coal-mining areas compilation
usgs_china_2014.license: USGS release; original metadata and source references retained
usgs_china_2014.attribution: USGS Trippi, Belkin, Dai, Tewalt and Chou, OFR2014-1219, source coal-mining areas as of 2001; retrieved 29 September 2026; Beijing1954 datum transformed by Earth research.
usgs_china_2014.limitation: Mapped coal-mining areas from historical atlas, not current mine operations or exhaustive coalfield geometry. Source reported coal rank retained. Does not prove continuous coal or surface access.

usgs_americas_2008.title: USGS coal-bearing areas in North, Central and South America
usgs_americas_2008.license: USGS public release; attribution and original source references retained
usgs_americas_2008.attribution: USGS Tewalt, Kinney and Merrill, OFR2008-1257; cited national geology/coal sources retained per feature. Retrieved 29 September 2026.
usgs_americas_2008.limitation: Small-scale approximations using appropriate-age surficial geology constrained by coal literature. Not adjusted for structure and excludes coal at depth; not suitable for resource-volume calculation. Do not reinterpret entire sedimentary units as continuous seams.

usgs_us_2012.title: Coal Fields of Conterminous US, NCRA updated version
usgs_us_2012.license: USGS public release; attribution and metadata retained
usgs_us_2012.attribution: USGS OFR2012-1205, updated Coal_Fields polygon layer, retrieved 29 September 2026; NAD83 to WGS84 transformation by Earth research.
usgs_us_2012.limitation: National generalized coalfields, includes inherited legacy boundaries. Detailed assessed thickness/overburden layers remain raw and are not mixed into resource extent counts. Overlaps the broader2008 Americas layer; not independent evidence.
